styleLock.backgroundSystem: airy light-blue diamond-lattice pattern #C9E4F4 for mood screens, crisp white #FFFFFF info screens, rose-pink #F2A7BC over light-blue color-block geometric panels for benefit screens, smooth light-grey concrete #EDEAE6 for lifestyle and macro shots

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh summer youth womens-sneaker ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of crisp white #FFFFFF, airy light-blue #C9E4F4, warm concrete grey #EDEAE6, rose-pink accent #E86C8C and a mint-teal secondary accent #4CB8A8 reserved for small highlight chips; cool tone; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; consistent thin outlined rounded-rectangle tag labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean bright product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement with balanced natural margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 源长图按 10 片 750x1200 切片逐片分析。归类判定：源夹名仅『鞋』、文件名仅序号 -(14)，图中出现『女鞋尺码对照表』35-40 码与成年女性上脚模特，故按taxonomy 判为 鞋靴/女鞋，leaf 以图中规格屏『单层冲孔透气网鞋』为准；与库内 xiexue-houdiwangshaxiaobaixie（厚底网纱）以单层轻薄薄底冲孔结构区分。已剥离：品牌名与货号、鞋侧卡通形象印花及字母装饰、图上文案（诗歌文案/卖点句/规格表数值 35-40 与 225-250mm 全部改为短句槽位由商家回填）、模特身份（仅保留裁切无脸的穿搭角色）。保留：菱格浅蓝底、粉蓝几何色块、水泥灰实拍面、编号细节条、双色平铺等可复用视觉语法；双栏信息屏与微距版式占比按版式口径保留。
